At that meeting, the committee considered a communication from the public requesting that Saskatoon declare itself a sanctuary city for undocumented refugees or immigrants.

The committee received the communication as information. As outlined in this report, the term sanctuary city has generally been used in the context of a municipality's treatment of handling or undocumented immigrants.
Shanks sanctuary cities commonly limit, commonly limit or deny cooperation with the national government in enforcing its immigration laws.
Sanctuary cities are more common outside of Canada but there are a handful of cities that have declared themselves sanctuary cities with respect to undocumented immigrants.
Important to note is that different jurisdictions have different legislative frameworks and other cities may have more of a role in providing enforcement services with respect to these issues.

There is limited information available with respect to 2 SLGBTQ Sanctuary cities. We could not find another Canadian city that has declared itself a sanctuary city for this purpose. Instead of this, the city has focused on specific initiatives to promote diversity and inclusion in Saskatoon.
